title: Audio joins chat completions
summary:
Audio entered chat completions, fast text got new model options, and Enter’s generation routes adopted one authentication and Pollen rule.

Chat completion requests gained OpenAI-compatible audio fields. Messages can include base64 audio in wav, mp3, flac, opus, or pcm16 format, and requests can specify text or audio output with a voice and format.

`openai-fast` moved to GPT-5 Nano. The new text-only `mistral-fast` offers Llama 3.1 8B with tool support and two additional aliases; `mistral-small` now points to Mistral Small 3.2. A button beside model pricing also gives visitors a route to vote on future models.

Enter’s text, image, and chat routes now require authentication and a positive Pollen balance for every model. The free-model pricing exception was removed; successful uncached requests are billed by usage. Publishable-key creation also gained a beta warning, while the key documentation clarified its existing limit.

highlights.title: Audio in chat completions
highlights.text: Send base64 `input_audio` in wav, mp3, flac, opus, or pcm16 format, or request audio output with a voice and format. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Llama 3.1 8B with tools
highlights.text: Use the new text-only `mistral-fast` model for Llama 3.1 8B with tool support. It also accepts `llama-3.1-8b` and `llama-fast` as aliases. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mistral-fast).

highlights.title: GPT-5 Nano on openai-fast
highlights.text: `openai-fast` now uses GPT-5 Nano instead of GPT-4.1 Nano. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-fast).
